cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you frame the club's prize certificate, put my name under cake design. I'll check the lettering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next year's members won't. Fill the blank, please; don't leave the record dependent on who happens to be here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We normally credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then list each name beside their job. I'll collect the names; leave the frame open until we've checked all of them.

reason: Use B's team-credit custom to expand accurate attribution rather than compete for sole credit; preserve A's specific contribution in the permanent record.
